categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: home-school interaction upgrade services, continuing education services, and education informatization project construction and operation. It also explores innovative businesses such as smart education applications, electronic student IDs, vocational education, smart sports, smart psychology, and children's attention enhancement. The continuing education segment focuses on teacher training and professional development, while education informatization involves providing digital and AI-enabled solutions for schools and education authorities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages technologies including IoT, big data, cloud computing, AI, facial recognition, and 5G to develop smart campus ecosystems and education platforms. It employs cloud services combined with mobile internet for service delivery and integrates AI models for personalized education and teacher evaluation. The production methods include software development, hardware procurement, system integration, and platform operation, with a focus on digital transformation and AI empowerment in education.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include schools at various levels (K12, vocational, higher education), education administrative departments, telecom operators (notably China Mobile), and education authorities across multiple provinces in China. The company serves millions of families indirectly through school services and directly supports teachers, students, and parents. The vocational education market and regional education platforms are also important customer segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant revenue contributions from regions including North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, Southwest, and Northeast China. It has established partnerships and platform deployments in provinces such as Guangdong, Zhejiang, Beijing, Shandong, Guangxi, and others. The company’s services cover over two thousand schools nationwide and collaborate with multiple provincial education bureaus.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the education supply chain, providing digital education platforms, software, hardware integration, and education services. It collaborates closely with telecom operators for platform deployment and with schools and education departments for service delivery. It also engages in content development and teacher training, positioning itself as a comprehensive education service provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include stabilizing and expanding core businesses (home-school interaction, education informatization, continuing education), exploring innovative education technologies (AI, smart sports, smart psychology), and deepening vocational education and industry-education integration. The company emphasizes AI model integration for personalized teacher evaluation and education data governance. It plans organizational optimization, cost reduction, efficiency improvement, and cross-business integration to enhance competitiveness and market position.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through project-based contracts, service subscriptions, and platform operation fees. The company earns income from software and hardware sales, education service contracts with government departments, telecom operators, and schools, as well as training service fees. It also receives government subsidies and investment income. The business model includes bidding for government-funded training projects and providing ongoing platform maintenance and value-added services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the education informatization and teacher continuing education sectors in China, with strong partnerships with China Mobile and education authorities. It competes with other education technology and service providers in a market influenced by rapid technological change and regulatory policies. Its early establishment and scale in teacher training and digital education platforms provide competitive advantages, though it faces risks from intensified industry competition and policy shifts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 442.6 million, a 31.26% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 104.48 million, a significant decline compared to prior profits. The decline was mainly due to policy impacts, reduced customer budgets, and increased credit impairment. The company’s total assets were about RMB 876.5 million, with net assets of RMB 594.6 million. Despite recent losses, the company maintains ongoing operations and plans strategic adjustments for recovery and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through comprehensive, integrated smart campus solutions combining IoT, AI, and big data to enhance school management, student wellbeing, and family engagement. Its deep collaboration with telecom operators and education authorities enables broad platform reach and service customization. The continuing education platform is a recognized leader with extensive teacher training resources. Innovation in smart sports, psychology, and attention enhancement services further strengthens its unique value proposition in personalized and technology-driven education.
